adjudication.evidence: Original N/E/U show a sustained ~14 mm N, ~4 mm E offset starting near index 544 and returning near index 589 (P1), with interior motion preserved. P2 (single point at 546) and P3 (single point at 555) are isolated spikes inconsistent with platform behavior; P4 (555–615) extends beyond the return and includes post-return motion, failing the opposing return criterion. Hypotheses P1–P4 confirm only the P1 interval yields clean residual flatness across all axes after subtraction, while others leave trends or spikes. The numerical tool’s accepted pulse/continuous criteria support a single platform centered on the observed step-and-return.
